#### .ctor

```text
public System.Void .ctor(System.String Label, System.String InsertText, PPDS.Dataverse.Sql.Intellisense.SqlCompletionKind Kind, System.String Description = default, System.String Detail = default, System.Int32 SortOrder = 0)
```

A single completion item for SQL IntelliSense.

- Parameter `Label`: Display label shown in the completion list.
- Parameter `InsertText`: Text inserted when the completion is accepted.
- Parameter `Kind`: The classification of this completion item.
- Parameter `Description`: Optional description shown in a detail pane.
- Parameter `Detail`: Optional short detail text (e.g., attribute type).
- Parameter `SortOrder`: Sort priority (lower values appear first).
